research_question: After correcting tokenization, how do training budget and parameterization affect MRPC performance and zero-shot robustness on PAWS-Wiki?
split_policy: Stratified 80/20 split of official train with seed 20260923; train subset for gradients, internal development subset for epoch selection; official 408-row validation only for final evaluation. Official test is not downloaded.
selection: Highest internal-development F1, then accuracy, then earliest epoch; no validation-based parameter tuning
lora_trainable: Low-rank matrices and full classification head; encoder weights and biases frozen
head_baseline: Frozen encoder in eval mode; cached first-token features; train the original dense/tanh/dropout classification head
precision: float32 master parameters with bfloat16 autocast on CUDA
limits: Method reproduction and controlled extension, not reproduction of all original paper tables
Internal train/development split further reduces gradient-training examples; three training seeds rather than the original five
Method learning rates are fixed before results, not exhaustively tuned; conclusions apply to this budget and protocol
Public validation is not a private held-out test; performance does not prove real-world generalization
Rank ablations use one seed and are diagnostic only
Elapsed times include method-specific operations and are not a controlled hardware benchmark
Corrected 4 and 12 epoch schedules are separate training runs; longer-run early epochs are not claimed identical to the 4-epoch schedule
PAWS is a public out-of-distribution stress test and is not used for checkpoint or hyperparameter selection
V3 validation outcomes were already observed; all MRPC extensions are explicitly exploratory
Primary ranks remain r8; r2/r16 diagnostics are single-seed only
phase: Post-v3 corrective and exploratory experiment; MRPC validation previously observed
tokenizer: AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained local pinned assets; all-row equality to tokenizers.Tokenizer.from_file(tokenizer.json)

stress_evaluation.selected_models: full and lora_r8, 12 epochs, all three seeds; internal MRPC development checkpoint selection only

error_analysis.scope: Paired query bootstrap within each paired training seed; three-seed SD reported separately; no claims of population equivalence

correction.v3_tokenization: legacy RobertaTokenizerFast resolved to a backend with zero BPE merges in transformers 5.15.1; input was character-segmented
correction.v3_result_scope: Valid arithmetic on malformed inputs, not valid standard RoBERTa/LoRA task results; replaced for application use
correction.training_math: same optimizer, batch, precision, split, classifier initialization, targets and method LRs as v3; only input path corrected for 4-epoch matched comparisons
